name: Seeed reTerminal E1001 (4-level grayscale)
description: 7.5 inch monochrome ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered (800x480), driven in the panel's 4-gray waveform mode. Pairs with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF grayscale build (seeed-reterminal-e1001-gray env) and speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API. Server-side pack via esp32_gray2_bin produces a raw 2-bpp 4-level grayscale buffer (96000 bytes) the firmware paints without any on-device decode.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Wire format is exactly 96000 bytes (800*480/4), row-major from top-left, 4 pixels per byte MSB first (bits 7-6 = leftmost pixel), 2-bit value 0b00 = black, 0b11 = white, linear 4-level gray; no header, no padding, no checksum. Same physical unit as `seeed_reterminal_e1001`; pick this kind when the unit runs the grayscale firmware build. The server migrates a registered E1001 to this kind automatically when its firmware re-registers or re-discovers declaring it (same-protocol kind heal).
